npcs.name: Wilhelmina "Billie" Roost
npcs.role: Founder of Roost Aeroworks, the little aircraft firm beside Meridian at Starling Flats. A retired air racer, seventy-four, selling up — to someone she likes.

npcs.name: Dr. Imogen Hale
npcs.role: Chief executive of Meridian Aerospace Corporation (MRDN), the incumbent at Starling Flats. Brilliant, polite, relentless; regards competition as a scheduling problem.

npcs.name: Ailie Ronn
npcs.role: Meridian's chief test pilot. Has flown every aircraft built on the Flats, most of them before they were finished.

npcs.name: Rudy Durr
npcs.role: Meridian's head of production. Owns the line board, every torque wrench on the Flats, and the phrase "not on my floor".

npcs.name: Tina Minus
npcs.role: Meridian's launch director. Runs every countdown on the Flats from launch control, to the hundredth of a second.

npcs.name: Wrenna Torq
npcs.role: Chief mechanic at Roost Aeroworks — and, by now, most of Roost Aeroworks. Stays on with the hangar when the firm is sold.
